tracks.label: Brand & Product
tracks.note: Films that make a single object impossible to ignore.

tracks.label: Concept / Future
tracks.note: Places remembered before they are built.

works.title: Bittersweet
works.alt: A premium dark chocolate bar on dark stone, a shard breaking away in raking light.
works.blurb: An artisan bar, broken to the light.

works.title: Effervesce
works.alt: A frosted beverage bottle beaded with condensation, backlit beside a frozen splash.
works.blurb: Beaded, backlit, one splash held mid-air.

works.title: Object Study
works.alt: A faceted glass perfume bottle on a lit pedestal in a dark studio, a faint mist of scent.
works.blurb: A faceted bottle, scent drifting in the dark.

works.title: Dewpoint
works.alt: A skincare serum dropper with a single golden droplet falling onto a wet polished surface.
works.blurb: One drop, falling onto wet light.

works.title: Cold Metal
works.alt: Minimalist wireless earbuds floating above a dark pedestal, edge-lit brushed metal and glass.
works.blurb: Brushed metal and glass, edge-lit and weightless.

works.title: The Floor
works.alt: A precision robotic arm on a clean production line amid sparks and shafts of light.
works.blurb: A production line in shafts of light and spark.

works.title: Neat
works.alt: A whiskey decanter and glass of amber spirit over a single clear ice sphere, lit from behind.
works.blurb: Amber over a single sphere of ice, lit from behind.

works.title: Bodywork
works.alt: A wet curved body panel of a dark luxury car reflecting long studio strip-lights.
works.blurb: A wet bodyline tracing studio light in the dark.

works.title: The Commons
works.alt: A civic plaza reclaimed as terraced gardens and water channels at golden hour.
works.blurb: A plaza reclaimed as terraced gardens and water.

works.title: The Market Hall
works.alt: A grand market hall reborn as a vertical farm, green walls under a glass roof.
works.blurb: A market reborn as a vertical farm under glass.

works.title: The Waterfront
works.alt: A regenerated river waterfront at sunset with wetlands, an elevated line, and low green towers.
works.blurb: A river's edge regrown — wetlands, transit, towers.

works.title: Vertical Village
works.alt: A residential green megastructure with cascading planted terraces lit at dusk.
works.blurb: A megastructure of cascading planted terraces.

works.title: The Interchange
works.alt: The interior of a future transit hall beneath a vaulted living roof of plants.
works.blurb: A transit hall beneath a living roof.
